import base64
from typing import Optional

from speech_client import build_client, get_text_to_speech_provider
from speech_models import SynthesisRequest, normalize_voice_name


def synthesize_text(text: str, voice: Optional[str] = None, language_code: Optional[str] = None) -> bytes:
    provider = get_text_to_speech_provider()
    client = build_client()
    request = SynthesisRequest(text=text, language_code=language_code, voice=normalize_voice_name(voice))
    if provider == "google":
        from google.cloud import texttospeech

        synthesis_input = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(text=request.text)
        voice_params = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(language_code=request.language_code or "en-US", name=request.voice or "en-US-Standard-C")
        audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(audio_encoding=texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3)
        response = client.synthesize_speech(input=synthesis_input, voice=voice_params, audio_config=audio_config)
        return bytes(response.audio_content)
    if provider == "azure":
        import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk

        speech_config = client
        ssml = f'<speak version="1.0" xml:lang="{request.language_code or "en-US"}"><voice name="{request.voice or "en-US-JennyNeural"}">{request.text}</voice></speak>'
        result = speechsdk.SpeechSynthesizer(speech_config=speech_config, audio_config=None).speak_ssml_async(ssml).get()
        return bytes(result.audio_data)
    if provider == "aws":
        response = client.synthesize_speech(Text=request.text, VoiceId=request.voice or "Joanna", OutputFormat="mp3", LanguageCode=request.language_code or "en-US")
        return response["AudioStream"].read()
    if provider == "openai":
        import requests

        api_key = client
        payload = {"model": "gpt-4o-mini-tts", "input": request.text, "voice": request.voice or "alloy", "format": "mp3"}
        response = requests.post("https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}, json=payload, timeout=60)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.content
    if provider == "elevenlabs":
        import requests

        api_key = client
        voice_id = request.voice or "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM"
        response = requests.post(f"https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}", headers={"xi-api-key": api_key, "accept": "audio/mpeg", "content-type": "application/json"}, json={"text": request.text, "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2"}, timeout=60)
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.content
    raise RuntimeError(f"Unsupported TTS provider: {provider}")

from typing import List, Optional

from speech_client import build_client, get_text_to_speech_provider
from speech_models import VoiceProfile


def select_voice(locale: str, preference: Optional[str] = None) -> List[VoiceProfile]:
    provider = get_text_to_speech_provider()
    client = build_client()
    profiles: List[VoiceProfile] = []
    if provider == "google":
        voices = client.list_voices(language_code=locale).voices
        for voice in voices:
            profiles.append(VoiceProfile(name=voice.name, language_codes=list(voice.language_codes), gender=getattr(voice.ssml_gender, "name", str(voice.ssml_gender)), provider="google"))
    elif provider == "azure":
        voices = client.get_voices()
        for voice in voices.voices:
            if locale.lower() in (voice.Locale or "").lower():
                profiles.append(VoiceProfile(name=voice.ShortName, language_codes=[voice.Locale], gender=voice.Gender, provider="azure", style=getattr(voice, "StyleList", None)))
    elif provider == "aws":
        response = client.describe_voices(LanguageCode=locale)
        for voice in response.get("Voices", []):
            profiles.append(VoiceProfile(name=voice["Id"], language_codes=[voice.get("LanguageCode", locale)], gender=voice.get("Gender", "Neutral"), provider="aws"))
    elif provider == "openai":
        profiles.append(VoiceProfile(name=preference or "alloy", language_codes=[locale], gender="neutral", provider="openai", model="gpt-4o-mini-tts"))
    elif provider == "elevenlabs":
        import requests

        api_key = client
        response = requests.get("https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices", headers={"xi-api-key": api_key}, timeout=30)
        response.raise_for_status()
        for voice in response.json().get("voices", []):
            labels = voice.get("labels", {})
            if locale.lower() in str(labels.get("language", locale)).lower():
                profiles.append(VoiceProfile(name=voice.get("name", ""), language_codes=[labels.get("language", locale)], gender=labels.get("gender", "neutral"), provider="elevenlabs", voice_id=voice.get("voice_id")))
    if preference:
        profiles.sort(key=lambda v: 0 if preference.lower() in v.name.lower() else 1)
    return profiles

from typing import Union


def save_audio(audio: bytes, destination: Union[str, Path]) -> str:
    path = Path(destination)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(audio)
    return str(path)

import os
from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Any


def get_text_to_speech_provider() -> str:
    return os.getenv("TTS_PROVIDER", "google").strip().lower()


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def build_client() -> Any:
    provider = get_text_to_speech_provider()
    if provider == "google":
        from google.cloud import texttospeech

        return texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient()
    if provider == "azure":
        import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk

        key = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"]
        region = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"]
        speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=key, region=region)
        return speech_config
    if provider == "aws":
        import boto3

        return boto3.client("polly", region_name=os.getenv("AWS_REGION"))
    if provider == "openai":
        return os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
    if provider == "elevenlabs":
        return os.environ["ELEVENLABS_API_KEY"]
    raise RuntimeError(f"Unsupported TTS provider: {provider}")

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional


@dataclass
class SynthesisRequest:
    text: str
    language_code: Optional[str] = None
    voice: Optional[str] = None
    rate: Optional[str] = None
    pitch: Optional[str] = None
    is_ssml: bool = False


@dataclass
class VoiceProfile:
    name: str
    language_codes: List[str]
    gender: str
    provider: str
    style: Optional[Any] = None
    voice_id: Optional[str] = None
    model: Optional[str] = None


@dataclass
class SynthesisResponse:
    audio: bytes
    content_type: str = "audio/mpeg"
    metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None


def normalize_voice_name(voice: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    if voice is None:
        return None
    cleaned = voice.strip()
    return cleaned or None

import os
from typing import Optional

from openai import OpenAI


def translate_script(script: str, target_language: str, source_language: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"])
    prompt = f"Translate the following narration script into {target_language}. Keep tone, timing, and meaning natural."
    if source_language:
        prompt += f" The source language is {source_language}."
    response = client.responses.create(model="gpt-4.1-mini", input=[{"role": "system", "content": prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": script}])
    return response.output_text

import os
from typing import Dict

from openai import OpenAI


def check_script_safety(script: str) -> Dict[str, object]:
    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"])
    response = client.responses.create(model="omni-moderation-latest", input=script)
    result = response.output[0].content[0].text if response.output and response.output[0].content else "{}"
    return {"raw": result, "provider": "openai", "model": "omni-moderation-latest"}

import io
import os
from typing import Optional

import openai


def transcribe_tts_sample(audio: bytes, language: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    client = openai.OpenAI(api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"])
    file_obj = io.BytesIO(audio)
    file_obj.name = "sample.wav"
    transcript = client.audio.transcriptions.create(model="gpt-4o-mini-transcribe", file=file_obj, language=language)
    return transcript.text
